definition: Branding is a form of non-therapeutic body modification in which the body or body parts are wounded to create marks, often as a cultural practice or as an expression of creativity or identity.

provenance.scope: Source record D046289; pinned source text

reasons: The packet supports branding as body modification done as a cultural practice or expression of creativity or identity, but it does not support the added frequency claim "often."
The definition’s wording “often as a cultural practice” is not supported by the packet text, which does not indicate frequency (“often”).

The packet’s provided wording defines branding via “wounding … by branding … as a cultural practice or expression of creativity or identity,” but does not connect “branding” to the field labeled “cognition” in any way.
